name: drumroll
title: DRUM ROLL step sequencer
summary: Channel-rack drum sequencer for the drum kit in a TE look: 8 lanes, each one drum sample with its own length (1-64 steps) and rate (1/4 .. 1/32, triplets), drawn to scale with bar / beat lines, loop lines and a playhead per lane. Every step has VEL, TONE (-24..+24 semitones), LEN (1/8 step .. 16 steps or FULL), NUDGE, PROB and RATCH; every sample a filter (LP / BP / HP, cutoff, resonance) and a level, also for keys played by hand. Follows the tape position while the tape runs, own clock otherwise, TE's tempo; 4 patterns, swing. Shift + green press on the drum screen opens it.

entry_hooks.what: drum engine pick: 'drum roll' row -> DRUM ROLL on the sound (TE skipped), dbox -> off

controls: drum engine list: 'drum roll' (next to dbox) turns DRUM ROLL on for the drum sound (its kit stays; kits picked afterwards are its sounds, dbox turns it off); DRUM ROLL is the sound's engine page (T1), T2-T4 stay TE's; shift + green press closes / opens it
tape screen (drum playmode): shift + white press = play / stop DRUM ROLL (to record it; it follows the tape position while the tape runs); not while the requantize screen is open
knob turn = the value under that knob, green press = next page, shift + blue turn = browse lanes; blue press = cursor step on / off (any page); white press = hear the cursor step
P1 STEP: step / ON / VEL / PROB; P2 NOTE: step / TONE / LEN / RATCH; P3 TIME: step / NUDGE / SWING / ZOOM; P4 LANE: SAMPLE / LENGTH / RATE / MUTE; P5 SOUND: FILTER / CUTOFF / RESO / LEVEL
shift + green turn: pattern A-D; shift + white press: play / stop; shift + orange press: clear the lane (again: undo); shift + blue press does nothing while open (no requantize take)
drum keys while open: select their lane (TE still plays them)
